nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Native n8n Error Trigger. Import this workflow first, then assign its n8n workflow ID in each project workflow.

nodes.name: Normalize & Redact Error
nodes.notes: Derives project/stage/severity/correlation/fingerprint from the error payload and redacts secret-like substrings. Group key suppresses alert storms within a window.

nodes.name: Write execution_audit
nodes.notes: Writes an execution_audit row for every handled failure. Verified Airtable credential bound for the target environment.

nodes.name: Write dead_letter
nodes.notes: Dead-letter record only when replay context exists. Verified Airtable credential bound for the target environment.

parameters.name: ={{ '[ALERT][' + $('Normalize & Redact Error').item.json.severity.toUpperCase() + '] ' + $('Normalize & Redact Error').item.json.workflow_name + ' — ' + $('Normalize & Redact Error').item.json.stage }}
